title: BCMT：块状因果记忆Transformer
summary: BCMT是一种用于长上下文语言建模的架构，通过局部块内密集自注意力与指数因果记忆的块摘要传播全局信息，避免全局注意力，实现并行化，训练吞吐量提升且内存消耗降低，性能与密集Transformer相当。
summary_en: BCMT is an architecture for long-context language modeling that decouples local token interactions from global context propagation using blockwise dense attention and exponential causal memory, achieving comparable performance with improved throughput and reduced memory.
